_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::xfem_fluid#6 and a FALSIFICATION. The entry claimed XFEM output appears as fluid_subdomain_0-*.vtu / fluid_subdomain_1-*.vtu. With the identical IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT + IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/FLUID block, the plain Fluid deck f3_stokes_residualbased_rotboxgeom writes fluid-00001-0.vtu plus a .pvd, while the Fluid_XFEM deck xfluid_ls_neumann_inflow_stab writes zero .vtu and zero .pvd, exits 0, prints 'processor 0 finished normally' and never mentions that the requested output was not produced. XFEM fluid results reach disk only as the legacy Ensight .result.fluid file and, with OUTPUT_GMSH, as .pos files. There are no sub-domain VTUs to load half of. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the XFEM arm the plain-Fluid deck, so both arms are non-XFEM. XFEM_VTU becomes 1 and the contrast disappears, so the fixture must go red.
